matching: Exact work excerpts at their original message offsets; maximum one-to-one matching; no semantic judge.
raw_candidates: PLAN/ACTION task objects in the untouched raw tool payload, before extractor/Host validation.
host_candidates: Verified field-grounded observations; source-only authority, never confirmed business tasks.
candidate_unit: Canonical source-message work units on both sides. Raw units are only structural splitting of exact supplied excerpts; no veto, field grounding or semantic validation. Untouched proposal count is also reported.
grouping: Evaluation-only groups.json allows explicit source continuations; a proposed group touching multiple independently labelled observations outside one allowed continuation counts as an erroneous candidate group. This is not business task confirmation.
missing: Missing raw work = model omission; present raw work lost after Host = Host rejection. Schema/provider failures stay separate.
nulls: Count nulls; fields on matched units only, always display recall alongside.
interpretation: All mock/cross-profile historical outputs are contract fixtures, not model quality. Public holdout is not blind.
